title: Bing Copilot Scraper: AI Mode Answers & Citations
metaDescription: Ask Bing's AI Mode (Copilot Search) any question and get the full answer, its numbered citations and every source it read, as markdown and JSON.
intro: Send questions to Bing's AI Mode (Copilot Search) and get the full answer, its numbered citations and every source it read, as markdown and JSON, in 28 markets. Track whether your brand and your domains are cited.
useCases: Track whether AI search cites your brand or your competitors
See which sources AI answers rely on for your topics
Monitor the AI answers to your key questions over time

faq.q: What does it return for each question?
faq.a: The whole Bing AI Mode (Copilot Search) answer: headline, summary, sections, lists and tables as markdown and plain text, the numbered citations, and every source page Bing read.

faq.q: Can I track whether my brand or site is cited?
faq.a: Yes. List the brands and domains you care about; each answer reports mentions per brand and, per domain, whether Bing cited it and at which citation number. That is the core of GEO / AEO tracking.
28 markets; Bing answers in that market's country and language.
A typical answer takes about 20 seconds without a browser, and several questions run side by side.

faq.q: Do I need a Microsoft account or API key?
faq.a: No. It works from your questions alone.

officialApi: Microsoft retired the Bing Search APIs, including Image Search and Visual Search, in August 2025; the replacement 'Grounding with Bing' only works inside Azure AI agents and returns no raw results. There is no API for Bing's AI Mode answers; this actor collects them with their citations.
